page.layout: One page of running text, one column, with headings in italic set between paragraphs. Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature mark at the foot.

main_text.l: ex hyperbolica metaphora oritur mira sublimitas
orationis cùm rebus inanimatis actum quendam, &
animos damus: ut, parietes, ut mihi videntur, hujus
curiae tibi gratias agere gestiunt, Cicero.
Synecdoche, Die begreiffung/ est cum pars usurpa-
tur & totum intelligitur, aut contrà. Synecdoche est
quadruplex: Membri, speciei, integri, aut generis.
Synecdoche membri, Die begreiffung des stücks/
est quando membrum usurpatur, & integrum intel-
ligitur: ut, anima sæpe ponitur in Bibliis, & intelli-
gitur totus homo. sic tectum ponitur pro domo, mu-
cro, ein spiţ[?] am gewehr/ pro gladio.
Synecdoche speciei, Die begreiffung einer eigent-
lichen substanz oder dinges/ est quando species usur-
patur, & genus intelligitur: ut, Si fueris Thrafo, non
deerit tibi Gnatho. Id est, Si fueris homo gloriosus
non deerit tibi assentator.
Synecdoche integri, Die begreiffung des ganzen/
est quando integrum usurpatur, & membrum intel-
ligitur: ut, pabula gustassent Trojae, Xanthumq; bi-
berent, Virgilius. Hic intelligis & partem pabuli, &
partem Xanthi fluvij.
Synecdoche generis, Die begreiffung des gemei-
nen/ est quando genus usurpatur, & species intelligi-
tur: ut, Apostolus, pro Paulo. Imperator pro Justinia-
no. Orator pro Cicerone aut Demosthene. Poeta pro
Virgil. aut Homero. Vulgus Antonomasiam vocat,
Sic pluralis numerus pro singulari: ut, Nos populo
imposuimus, & Oratores visi sumus, Cicero.

page.notes: Page is printed in roman with italic headings; German words set in black letter are marked with bl. "spiţ[?]" in the line "ein spiţ am gewehr" is uncertain (the letter after the long s-like form). Printed "Juftinia-no" and "gemei-nen" are hyphenated at line ends as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout (e.g., "fublimitas", "guftaffent", "impofuimus", "fumus"). Signature "r 5" read from the foot of the page.
